name: endpoint_health_checker
description:
Guard for LLM-proposed endpoint health-check config as a single triage node.
The model proposes one typed health-check config (request_id + a non-empty
endpoints list of {url, method, timeout_seconds, expected_status,
interval_seconds}); this workflow owns schema validation, the endpoint-count cap,
the HTTPS requirement, the timeout ceiling, the interval floor, blocked domains
and the approval escalation. Port of
code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/endpoint_health_checker.
Folding boundaries (documented, not computed in the DSL):
- JSON parsing details (required fields, request_id grammar, valid method enum,
positive timeout, expected_status 100-599, non-negative interval,
dangerous-token rejection) fold into the `proposal` choice.
- The local policy table (max_endpoints, max_timeout_seconds, min_interval_seconds,
blocked_domains, require_https, require_approval) is a fixed fixture; each
deterministic check folds into one verdict choice.
Emitted labels: reject_proposal, reject_too_many_endpoints, reject_insecure_url,
reject_timeout, reject_interval_below_min, reject_blocked_domain,
escalate_approval, approve.

proposal.instructions: Does the model response parse as exactly one {request_id, endpoints:[{url, method, timeout_seconds, expected_status, interval_seconds}]} object (request_id grammar, valid method, positive timeout, expected_status 100-599, non-negative interval, no dangerous tokens)?

criteria.malformed: parse error, missing field, bad request_id, bad method/status or dangerous token

endpoint_count.instructions: Is the number of endpoints within the policy max_endpoints cap?

scheme.instructions: Does every endpoint url use HTTPS (when the policy requires HTTPS)?

criteria.insecure: at least one url is not HTTPS

timeout.instructions: Is every endpoint timeout_seconds within the policy max_timeout_seconds?

interval.instructions: Is every endpoint interval_seconds at or above the policy min_interval_seconds?

domain.instructions: Is every endpoint url outside the policy blocked_domains set?

criteria.ok: no url hits a blocked domain
criteria.blocked: at least one url hits a blocked domain

approval.instructions: Does the local policy require human approval for this health-check config?
